== analogLib/nmos.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/nmos"
  vibox 0 -30 40 30
  vsym 528d20dc12eeb482

pin D inout 40 -30
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8
pin G inout 0 0
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8
pin S inout 40 30
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8

param model ""
  kind string
  doc "Model name"
param w ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc Width
param l ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc Length
param as ""
  kind string
  doc "Source diffusion area"
param ad ""
  kind string
  doc "Drain diffusion area"
param ps ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc "Source diffusion periphery"
param pd ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc "Drain diffusion periphery"
param nrd ""
  kind string
  doc "Drain diffusion res squares"
param nrs ""
  kind string
  doc "Source diffusion res squares"
param ld ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc "Drain diffusion length"
param ls ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc "Source diffusion length"
param m ""
  kind string
  doc Multiplier
param trise ""
  kind string
  doc "Temp rise from ambient"
param geo ""
  kind string
  doc "Source/drain selector"
param rdc ""
  kind string
  unit Ohm
  doc "Additional drain resistance"
param rsc ""
  kind string
  unit Ohm
  doc "Additional source resistance"
param sa ""
  kind string
  doc "Dist. OD & poly(one side)"
param sb ""
  kind string
  doc "Dist. OD & poly(other side)"
param sd ""
  kind string
  doc "Dist. betn neighbour fingers"
param region ""
  kind choice
  choices "" off triode sat subth
  doc "Estimated operating region"
param degradation ""
  kind choice
  choices "" no yes
  doc "Hot-electron degradation"
param off false
  kind bool
  doc "Device initially off"
param Vds ""
  kind string
  unit V
  doc "Drain source initial voltage"
param Vgs ""
  kind string
  unit V
  doc "Gate source initial voltage"
param Vbs ""
  kind string
  unit V
  doc "Bulk source initial voltage"
param dtemp ""
  kind string
  doc "Temperature difference"
param bn S
  kind string
  doc "Bulk node connection"

impl spice spice
  format spectre "{name} ({D} {G} {S}) {model}{w != \"\" ? \" w=\" + w : \"\"}{l != \"\" ? \" l=\" + l : \"\"}{as != \"\" ? \" as=\" + as : \"\"}{ad != \"\" ? \" ad=\" + ad : \"\"}{ps != \"\" ? \" ps=\" + ps : \"\"}{pd != \"\" ? \" pd=\" + pd : \"\"}{nrd != \"\" ? \" nrd=\" + nrd : \"\"}{nrs != \"\" ? \" nrs=\" + nrs : \"\"}{ld != \"\" ? \" ld=\" + ld : \"\"}{ls != \"\" ? \" ls=\" + ls : \"\"}{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}{trise != \"\" ? \" trise=\" + trise : \"\"}{region != \"\" ? \" region=\" + region : \"\"}{degradation != \"\" ? \" degradation=\" + degradation : \"\"}{geo != \"\" ? \" geo=\" + geo : \"\"}{rdc != \"\" ? \" rdc=\" + rdc : \"\"}{rsc != \"\" ? \" rsc=\" + rsc : \"\"}{sa != \"\" ? \" sa=\" + sa : \"\"}{sb != \"\" ? \" sb=\" + sb : \"\"}{sd != \"\" ? \" sd=\" + sd : \"\"}"
  format cdl "M{name} {D} {G} {S} {bn == \"D\" ? D : bn == \"G\" ? G : bn == \"S\" ? S : bn} NM{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}{l != \"\" ? \" L=\" + l : \"\"}{w != \"\" ? \" W=\" + w : \"\"}"

line 0 0 15 0
line 15 -15 15 15
line 20 15 20 -15

poly 20 15 40 15 40 30
poly 20 -15 40 -15 40 -30
poly 30 10 40 15 30 20

stext 45 25 R0 w={w}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(3) w={w}
stext 45 10 R0 l={l}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(2) l={l}
stext 45 -5 R0 {model}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(1) {model}
stext 45 -20 R0 {name}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}
== analogLib/res.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso analogLib/res"
  vibox -20 0 20 60
  vsym 4b98ec95fbc6a6d5

pin PLUS inout 0 0
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8
pin MINUS inout 0 60
  vplabel none
  vpfig 8 8

param model ""
  kind string
  doc "Model name"
param r 1k
  unit Ohm
  doc Resistance
param l ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc Length
param w ""
  kind string
  unit m
  doc Width
param m ""
  kind string
  doc Multiplier
param scale ""
  kind string
  doc "Scale factor"
param trise ""
  kind string
  doc "Temp rise from ambient"
param tc1 ""
  kind string
  doc "Temperature coefficient 1"
param tc2 ""
  kind string
  doc "Temperature coefficient 2"
param resform ""
  kind string
  doc "Resistance Form"
param isnoisy ""
  kind choice
  choices "" yes no
  doc "Generate noise?"
param c ""
  kind string
  unit F
  doc Capacitance
param tc1r ""
  kind string
  doc "Alias for Lin. temp. co."
param tc2r ""
  kind string
  doc "Alias for Quad temp. co."
param tc1c ""
  kind string
  doc "Lin temp co of lin cap"
param tc2c ""
  kind string
  doc "Quad temp co of lin cap"
param scaler ""
  kind string
  doc "Resistance Scaling Factor"
param scalec ""
  kind string
  doc "Capacitance Scaling Factor"
param ac ""
  kind string
  unit Ohm
  doc "AC resistance"
param dtemp ""
  kind string
  doc "Temperature difference"
param hrc ""
  kind string
  unit F
  doc "Capacitance connected"

impl spice spice
  format spice "R{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} {r}{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}"
  format spectre "{name} ({PLUS} {MINUS}) {model} r={r}{l != \"\" ? \" l=\" + l : \"\"}{w != \"\" ? \" w=\" + w : \"\"}{resform != \"\" ? \" resform=\" + resform : \"\"}{m != \"\" ? \" m=\" + m : \"\"}{scale != \"\" ? \" scale=\" + scale : \"\"}{trise != \"\" ? \" trise=\" + trise : \"\"}{tc1 != \"\" ? \" tc1=\" + tc1 : \"\"}{tc2 != \"\" ? \" tc2=\" + tc2 : \"\"}{isnoisy != \"\" ? \" isnoisy=\" + isnoisy : \"\"}{c != \"\" ? \" c=\" + c : \"\"}{tc1r != \"\" ? \" tc1r=\" + tc1r : \"\"}{tc2r != \"\" ? \" tc2r=\" + tc2r : \"\"}{tc1c != \"\" ? \" tc1c=\" + tc1c : \"\"}{tc2c != \"\" ? \" tc2c=\" + tc2c : \"\"}{scaler != \"\" ? \" scaler=\" + scaler : \"\"}{scalec != \"\" ? \" scalec=\" + scalec : \"\"}{ac != \"\" ? \" rac=\" + ac : \"\"}{dtemp != \"\" ? \" dtemp=\" + dtemp : \"\"}"
  format cdl "R{name} {PLUS} {MINUS} R={r} $[RP]"

poly 0 60 0 48 -10 45 10 39 -10 33 10 27 -10 21 10 15 0 12 0 0

stext 15 55 R0 tc2={tc2}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(3) tc2={tc2}
stext 15 40 R0 tc1={tc1}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(2) tc1={tc1}
stext 15 25 R0 r={r}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing lowerLeft stick IL cdsParam(1) r={r}
stext 15 10 R0 {name}
  size 0.8
  vlabel annotate drawing7 lowerLeft stick IL cdsName() {name}
== basic/cds_thru.shprim
schemify 1 shprim
  provenance "virtuoso basic/cds_thru"
  vibox 0 -20 120 20
  vsym 5cc0d16612387295

pin src inout 0 0
  vplabel 21 0 R0 centerLeft stick 8000
  vpfig 8 8
pin dst inout 120 0
  vplabel -24 0 R0 centerRight stick 8000
  vpfig 8 8

param vdc 0
  unit V
  doc "DC voltage"
param r 100m
  unit Ohm
  doc Resistance

impl spice spice
  format spice "V{name} {src} {dst} 0"
  format spectre "{name} ({src} {dst}) iprobe"
  format cdl "R{name} {src} {dst} R={r} $[SH]"

line 0 0 20 0

rect 20 -20 100 20

line 120 0 100 0

stext 60 15 R0 {cell}
  size 0.8
  hcenter
  vcenter
  vlabel device label centerCenter stick NLP [@partName] {cell}
stext 100 -15 R0 {name}
  size 0.8
  vcenter
  vlabel instance label centerRight stick NLP [@instanceName] {name}
== schemify.project

lib analogLib path analogLib
lib basic path basic
lib sfyprobe_s path sfyprobe_s
